name: Applications compose capabilities and carry none: FeltOS, MetroPlat and MARSH dissolve into the services sections
asks: Leader, 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-28: "METROPLAT, FELTOS, NONE OF THIS SHIT SHOULD CARRY ANY CAPABILITIES ITSELF"; "Windows 11 does not contain Grand Theft Auto"; "MetroPlat is meant to be a library for FeltOS, the way Discworld Mudlib is a library for FluffOS"; "I'm trying to get us to have ONE CODEBASE". Full words by address in provenance.

x-provenance.recorded-by: metroplat-feltos-node pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: Capabilities live once, in the services section that owns them; applications only compose and parameterize them.

requirements.says: Each atomic capability of the house shall have exactly one script, held in the services section that owns its domain.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "We should have exactly one script for doing each atomic action"; the scripts "are meant to be scripts under the services-section".

requirements.says: FeltOS shall compose scripts of other services sections and shall carry no topology of its own.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-11: FeltOS "should compose other services sections scripts and carry literally almost no logic itself"; "FeltOS should have NO FUCKING TOPOLOGY SHIT ITSELF".

requirements.says: FeltOS shall read and write files only through the computer-file engineering section.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: the computer-file-engineering-services-section "should provide our stuff for working with files".

requirements.says: MetroPlat shall carry no capability of its own and shall be the library FeltOS loads, as the Discworld mudlib is the library of the FluffOS driver.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: MetroPlat "should be NOTHING but a UX for MARSH" and carry no capabilities; Leader, 2026-09-28: MetroPlat "is meant to be a library for FeltOS, the way Discworld Mudlib is a library for FluffOS".

requirements.says: The MetroPlat package shall contain nothing that does not provide the user experience of MARSH or the library role of FeltOS.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "anything that is not about providing a UX to MARSH should be relocated into other packages that should actually carry these capabilities".

requirements.says: Every capability found in MetroPlat, FeltOS or MARSH shall be moved to the services section that owns its domain, and every consumer shall be cut over to depend on that section directly.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "ACTUALLY cut over consumers to rely on the real parent package"; "dissolving applications capabilities into services section so that applications can share them"; the answer to "should I fix metroplat?" is to continue dissolving it.

requirements.says: The codebase shall contain no re-export shim: no module whose only content is the re-export of an upstream package.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-11: re-export shims are "another kind of contamination"; "Stop fucking using Metroplat for thin re-export shims".

requirements.says: The house shall carry no product named infograph, and no package shall be named for a word no Leader statement or house term defines.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "I have never heard of 'infograph' and it sounds like some AI slop application you keep passing around between things".

requirements.says: The Bare Cedar Fog section shall hold configuration that parameterizes upstream packages and shall hold no program code that duplicates upstream.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-12: Bare Cedar Fog "SHOULD ONLY PARAMETERIZE UPSTREAM SHIT, LITERALLY ONLY CONFIG FILES, NOT CODE".

requirements.says: The house's executable code shall be one Node codebase, with no Python and no variant implementations of a capability beside it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-21: "I'm trying to get us to have ONE CODEBASE … Like how Unity is ONE piece of code … CERTAINLY not a bunch of random python".

requirements.says: Each capability that exists only in an agent hook shall be held by the engineering section of its domain, and the hook shall only invoke it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "Move any capabilities that exist only in your hooks (i.e. filtering on header comment lengths in node files) … into the actual engineering services section for that stuff, i.e. javascript fabrication engineering"; the hook on node:fs "is stupid to begin with".

requirements.says: The house shall carry one npm configuration for the repository and one canonical registry, registry.561.group, and no package shall be pointed at a localhost registry.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-08-26: "why don't we just have one .npmrc at repo root … putting 'use a localhost registry' in our npmrc seems stupid"; Leader, 2026-09-28: "we should have https://registry.561.group running on Cold Red Gate as a Verdaccio registry for our network".

requirements.says: The inventory of capabilities carried by an application that does not own them shall list each by the section that owns it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-21: an engineering section named Actor bore no relation to the house's research definition of Actor; the owning section must be identifiable.

conditions.says: A reader comparing the packages of FeltOS, MetroPlat and MARSH with the services sections finds no capability script in an application package that a services section owns, and no re-export shim.
The repository's executable files are Node, and its npm configuration names one registry.

board-opening.context: Held theory: the 2026-10-10 note on where a capability lives (computer-science section). Held glossary: feltos, metroplat, marsh. The Leader's two statements about MetroPlat (nothing but a UX for MARSH, 2026-09-11; a library for FeltOS, 2026-09-28) are both kept; the later states the layering.
